tools.name: sharescan
tools.description: Pre-share leak check ($0.005 USDC via x402). Scan text or an https text URL for your own terms (plain list, or salted-hash list sent per call, never stored) plus leak-shaped strings: emails, coordinates, IPs, AWS/GitHub/Slack/sk- keys, private keys, JWTs. Binary URLs are listed as unscanned. Max 10

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "sharescan" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sharescan · Private data: sharescan · Public sink: sharescan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sharescan · Private data: sharescan · Public sink: sharescan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
